statements: People complain that our notifications wake them up at night. Add sendTime(user, notification, now) to src/schedule.mjs, returning the time in milliseconds at which the notification should go out.
Follow what the company has decided about this.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Stop notifications waking people at night, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and repository and change only what the ticket needs.
